name: Next JS (Full Modules + Cloudflared + Cron)
author: custom
description: Full Next.js server with version control, modules, cloudflared, and cron support.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git curl wget cron bash

curl -fsSL https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/cloudflared
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cloudflared

cat > /mnt/server/start-modules.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# NEXT VERSION INSTALL (AUTO)
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "Creating Next.js project..."
  npm init -y
  npm install next@${NEXT_VERSION:-latest} react react-dom
fi

# START NEXT
npx next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p ${SERVER_PORT} &
NEXT_PID=$!

# CRON MODULE
if [ "${CRON_STATUS}" = "1" ]; then
  service cron start || true
  cron -f &
fi

# CLOUDFLARED MODULE
if [ "${CLOUDFLARED_STATUS}" = "1" ]; then
  cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate run --token ${CLOUDFLARED_TOKEN} &
fi

wait $NEXT_PID
EOF

chmod +x /mnt/server/start-modules.sh

echo "install complete"
exit 0
